note: Condensed reference to Ableton's Live Object Model, the API a MIDI Remote Script can reach. Covers the members crableton uses or that are useful for reasoning about what Live can do; it is not the complete model, and availability varies by Live version and edition. Members marked read-only cannot be changed by any tool, however the request is phrased.

classes.name: Clip
classes.path: live_set tracks N clip_slots M clip

properties.name: color
properties.description: Colour as 0xRRGGBB.

properties.name: is_midi_clip
properties.description: True for MIDI clips.

properties.name: is_audio_clip

properties.name: is_arrangement_clip

properties.name: length
properties.description: Playing length in beats, derived from the markers and loop.

properties.name: looping
properties.description: Whether the clip loops.

properties.name: loop_start
properties.description: Loop start in beats.

properties.name: loop_end
properties.description: Loop end in beats. Must exceed loop_start.

properties.name: start_marker
properties.description: Playback start marker.

properties.name: end_marker
properties.description: Playback end marker.

properties.name: start_time
properties.description: Arrangement clips: position on the timeline. There is no API to move a clip, delete it and re-place it instead.

properties.name: end_time
properties.description: Arrangement clips: where the clip ends on the timeline.

properties.name: muted
properties.description: Whether the clip is deactivated.

properties.name: signature_numerator

properties.name: signature_denominator
properties.description: Clip time signature: beat unit.

properties.name: launch_mode
properties.description: 0 = Trigger, 1 = Gate, 2 = Toggle, 3 = Repeat.

properties.name: launch_quantization
properties.description: Per-clip launch quantization; 0 follows the set's global setting.

properties.name: legato

properties.name: velocity_amount
properties.description: How much launch velocity affects the clip.

properties.name: follow_action_enabled
properties.description: Whether the clip triggers a follow action.

properties.name: follow_time

properties.name: follow_action_a
properties.description: First follow action.

properties.name: follow_action_b

properties.name: follow_action_chance_b

properties.name: warping

properties.name: warp_mode

properties.name: gain

properties.name: pitch_coarse

properties.name: pitch_fine
properties.description: Audio clips: fine tuning in cents, -50 to 50.

properties.name: ram_mode
properties.description: Audio clips: load the sample into RAM.

properties.name: file_path

properties.name: is_playing

properties.name: playing_position
properties.description: Current playback position in beats.

properties.name: will_record_on_start
properties.description: Whether launching this clip starts recording.

methods.name: get_notes_extended(from_pitch, pitch_span, from_time, time_span)

methods.name: add_new_notes(specification)

methods.name: apply_note_modifications(notes)

methods.name: remove_notes_extended(from_pitch, pitch_span, from_time, time_span)

methods.name: get_notes(from_time, from_pitch, time_span, pitch_span)

methods.name: set_notes(notes)
methods.description: Older API: replace notes with a tuple list.

methods.name: select_all_notes()

methods.name: quantize(grid, amount)

methods.name: quantize_pitch(pitch, grid, amount)
methods.description: Quantize only the notes of one pitch, useful for tightening a single drum lane.

methods.name: crop()
methods.description: Discard everything outside the loop brace.

methods.name: duplicate_loop()
methods.description: Double the loop length, copying the contents into the new half.

methods.name: duplicate_region(start, length, destination_time)
methods.description: Copy a region of the clip to another position within it.

methods.name: fire()
methods.description: Launch the clip.

methods.name: stop()
methods.description: Stop the clip.

methods.name: automation_envelope(parameter)
methods.description: The clip's automation for a parameter, creating it on demand. Pass None to clear it.

methods.name: clear_envelope(parameter)
methods.description: Remove the clip's automation for a parameter.

methods.name: clear_all_envelopes()
methods.description: Remove every automation envelope in the clip.

methods.name: get_warp_markers()
methods.description: Audio clips: the warp markers.

methods.name: set_fire_button_state(state)
methods.description: Hold or release the launch button.

classes.name: DeviceParameter
classes.path: live_set tracks N devices M parameters K
classes.description: One automatable control. This is the object every parameter-setting tool ultimately writes to.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Parameter name, e.g. "Filter Freq".

properties.name: original_name
properties.description: The name before any macro renaming.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Current value, in the parameter's own units, between `min` and `max`. Not normalised, a frequency parameter's value may be in hertz.

properties.name: min
properties.description: Lowest accepted value.

properties.name: max
properties.description: Highest accepted value.

properties.name: default_value
properties.description: The value the parameter resets to.

properties.name: is_quantized
properties.description: True when the parameter steps between named settings rather than varying continuously. For these, `value` is the index of the setting.

properties.name: value_items
properties.description: For a quantized parameter, the named settings in order, this is how you learn that a filter type of 2 means Bandpass.

properties.name: is_enabled
properties.description: Whether the parameter can currently be changed.

properties.name: automation_state
properties.description: 0 = none, 1 = playing automation, 2 = overridden.

properties.name: state
properties.description: 0 = enabled, 1 = irrelevant, 2 = locked by a macro mapping.

methods.name: str_for_value(value)
methods.description: Format a value the way Live displays it, e.g. "2.5 kHz" or "-6.0 dB". The only reliable way to know what a raw number means to the user.

methods.name: re_enable_automation()
methods.description: Re-engage automation after the parameter was overridden.
